# FlowForm

> Open-source, self-hostable headless form backend and multi-step workflow API built on Laravel.

FlowForm receives HTML `<form>` posts (`POST /f/{slug}`) and JSON/multipart API posts (`POST /api/v1/f/{slug}`) without custom backend code, with built-in honeypot filtering (`_gotcha`), Turnstile/hCaptcha verification, file uploads, optional AES-256 field-level encryption, HMAC-SHA256 webhooks, scoped Sanctum API tokens, and an authenticated MCP server (`POST /api/v1/mcp`). Self-hosted instances bring their own SMTP provider for email notifications.

## AI Agent & Endpoint Quickstarts

- [AI Coding Agents Quickstart](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/ai-agents): 3-step contact form setup, exact JSON response contract, honeypot rules, and authenticated MCP tools (`POST /api/v1/mcp`)
- [Endpoints Overview](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/): `/f/{slug}` vs `/api/v1/f/{slug}`, reserved fields, response codes, CORS, and Allowed Domains

## Stack Guides

- [HTML Forms](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/html): Plain HTML `<form>` endpoints, `_gotcha` honeypot, and redirect rules
- [JavaScript (fetch & FormData)](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/javascript): Browser `fetch` JSON and `FormData` file uploads
- [Next.js](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/nextjs): App Router Server Actions and Client Components
- [Astro](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/astro): Static `<form>` and SSR Astro Actions
- [Nuxt](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/nuxt): Vue `$fetch` form component
- [SvelteKit](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/sveltekit): Server-side form actions with progressive enhancement
- [Static Site Generators](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/static-site-generators): Hugo, Eleventy, and Jekyll snippets
- [Mobile & Server Clients](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/endpoints/mobile-and-servers): curl, React Native, Flutter, Python, and PHP/Laravel clients

## API, MCP & Security

- [API Overview](https://docs.flowformhq.com/api/overview): Sanctum bearer authentication, pagination, and error format
- [Forms API](https://docs.flowformhq.com/api/forms): Headless endpoint routes and schema-driven form endpoints
- [Submissions API](https://docs.flowformhq.com/api/submissions): Draft creation, step navigation, and field value persistence
- [Webhooks & HMAC Verification](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/webhooks): `X-FlowForm-Signature` verification and retry schedule
- [Field-Level Encryption](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/security-encryption): AES-256 at-rest encryption and decryption audit logging
- [Self-Hosting Guide](https://docs.flowformhq.com/guide/deployment): Docker Compose and Laravel deployment
